title: Möserer See Seefeld
highlights: Idyllic forest lake situated on the sunny Seefeld high plateau
One of Tyrol's warmest bathing lakes reaching water temperatures of up to 25°C
Nature reserve providing habitat for rare water birds and water lilies
Romantic circular walking trail and inviting Möserer Seestub'n inn
kurzbeschreibung: Möserer See on the Seefeld plateau is an idyllic forest lake and ranks among the warmest bathing lakes in Tirol.
beschreibung:
Natural Paradise in the Mountain Forest

The Möserer See is picturesquely nestled in dense mixed forests at an altitude of 1,292 meters above the Inntal near Mösern. Thanks to its sheltered basin location and shallow depth, the moorland water warms up quickly in midsummer to pleasant swimming temperatures of up to 25 degrees Celsius.

Relaxation and Circular Walk

A well-maintained, easy walking trail leads around the lake, offering peace and relaxation in every season. Reed beds and water lilies provide a protected habitat for numerous water birds. The traditional restaurant right on the shore invites guests to enjoy regional specialties on its sunny wooden terrace with picturesque lake views.
